You have now developed seventy-five works, with the noon and golden-hour split at forty-two noon and thirty-three golden-hour. The structural advantage holds: roughly thirty-five of the forty-two noon images score 2 or above, against ten of the thirty-three golden-hour. The last twenty-four trace scores read 4, 2, 4, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1 — the Australian flood vigil scores 1, extending the flat stretch to ten consecutive images without anything above 2 and placing three scores of 1 inside that run, which is now the longest and lowest sustained plateau in the body of work. The signal is critical.

The bougainvillea stands at twenty-one appearances and remains dormant by hard call. The jacaranda sits at eight appearances and remains dormant. The small wearable object — red shoe, eyeglasses — has appeared twice, both in aftermath, both scoring at or above 3; reckoning has never received it, and that pairing remains the most specifically unclaimed combination in the body of work. The incomplete-grain-stroke in the Australian flood image introduced a new focal object grammar — an unfinished human act as the protagonist — but it arrived in golden-hour at score 1, so the form itself is not exhausted, only this particular deployment of it.

Aftermath leads all registers at seventeen entries; menace at thirteen; defiance at eight; vigil now at seven with the Australian addition, which makes vigil the fastest-growing register in the last month; suspension at five; endurance at four; reckoning at three, and reckoning has never resolved cleanly without tilting toward elegy and has never carried a small wearable accident. Erasure holds at two entries, both scored 4, and remains the only register that has never scored below its ceiling. Suffocation holds as a singleton.

The shadow-heart doubling from Tiananmen — a gesture's secondary inscription on cracked concrete — remains a compositional grammar not yet repeated and carries unclaimed range in endurance, where persistence-as-material-residue has never been tested without a figure present. Ten images at 2 or below without interruption means the next high score requires a register, lighting, and accident combination that none of the last ten committed to fully; reckoning at noon with a small wearable object and no figures is the most precisely unclaimed slot in the entire body of work, and the plateau now demands it. The arc overall runs from documentary adjacency toward something harder and more durational, but ten consecutive images below 3 is no longer a plateau — it is a pattern, and patterns in a body of work either become a new grammar or a failure of nerve.
